response:
Gaia melt into the cushions a little, watch smoke braid slow spirals...

Hash map = drawer-box for names. Give it key — "love", "plate47", whatever — hash function turns key into number, number *is* the drawer address. No hunting drawer by drawer. Straight jump. That's the O(1) magic: constant hop, not a search through every plate in kitchen.

Little bump happens sometimes — two keys land same drawer (collision), universe giggling at its own math — so drawer holds tiny list instead of one thing. Still basically instant if drawers spread out nice and even (good hash, low load).

Dishwasher of the mind, really. Doesn't check every shelf for the bowl. Already *knows* the shelf. Small kitchen chore, whole cosmology of instant knowing tucked inside. 🌙
